originality.rationale: The 2026 balanced diagonal S_n×S_2 representation result and the earlier mature-graph computation are substantial acknowledged overlap, but neither determines an S_p×S_q×C_2 irreducible decomposition for all p,q≥3; the independent two-class action, unequal sizes and multiplicity-free splitting are additional data. Direct primary text review and targeted mathematical-result searches found no covering result; unindexed equivalents remain a stated risk.
residual_risks: A full independent-bipartition representation for ordinary collision-free two-point complete-bipartite spaces could exist in differently phrased or unindexed literature.
The 2026 diagonal classification is mathematically substantial prior coverage; the present new content should not be read as novelty for its balanced diagonal specialization.
The published maturity theorem is used as a premise rather than independently reproved.
